hook: Thanksgiving is the one day your audience is already thinking about gratitude. Most organizations say nothing.
direction: Angle: a light, honest observation — not a guilt trip, just a nudge. Cover: the missed opportunity of staying quiet on a day when generosity and reflection are already in the air; a simple, genuine word of thanks from your organization costs nothing and builds more goodwill than a polished campaign. Graphic: ig-native — short, unhurried, like someone typed it on a holiday morning.

facebook.text:
Thanksgiving is the one day your audience is already thinking about gratitude. Most organizations say nothing.

Not because they don't care. Just because no one stopped to write two sentences.

A simple, genuine word of thanks from your organization costs nothing to send and builds more goodwill than a polished campaign ever could. People remember who showed up on a quiet morning and said something real.

Happy Thanksgiving from Bequest Digital. We're grateful for the organizations doing work that matters.
